column.headline: Shantanu storms up as Haaland armband backfires
column.text: Shantanu was the story of the week, hauling 65 points to climb from 22nd to 20th and spark a wild week. At the top, Sukrut still leads on 742, 24 ahead of Aditya Dalal, while Prerana sits 3 further back. Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson has to pay off after returning 25. Haaland was the house captain for 15 managers and scored just 2, so the lone-wolf armband picks made the drama.

history: GW11 between: Shantanu storms up as Haaland armband backfires. Shantanu was the story of the week, hauling 65 points to climb from 22nd to 20th and spark a wild week. At the top, Sukrut still leads on 742, 24 ahead of Aditya Dalal, while Prerana sits 3 further back. Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson has to pay off after returning 25. Haaland was the house captain for 15 managers and scored just 2, so the lone-wolf armband picks made the drama.

GW11 between: Shantanu storms the table as Sukrut holds firm. Shantanu hauled 65 points to win GW11 and climb from 22nd to 20th, the standout week of the season so far. At the top, Sukrut still leads on 742, 24 clear of Aditya Dalal, with Prerana only 3 further back. Aryamann's 52 pushed him up to 4th, and Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson has to pay off after returning 25. Haaland was the house captain for 15 managers and scored just 2, so lone-wolf picks made the drama.

GW11 between: Shantanu storms the table as Sukrut holds on top. Shantanu hauled 65 points to win GW11 and climb from 22nd to 20th, the standout performance of the week. At the top, Sukrut still leads on 742 with a 24-point cushion over Aditya Dalal, and Aryamann's 52 lifted him to 4th. Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson is the first thing he now has to justify. Haaland was the house captain for most of the league, so the lone-wolf picks made the drama.

GW11 between: Shantanu storms in as Sukrut keeps the top spot. Shantanu hauled 65 points to win the week and climb from 22nd to 20th, while Sukrut still sits top on 742 with a 24-point cushion over Aditya Dalal. Aryamann's 52 lifted him up to 4th, and Aary's 8-point hit for Groß, De Cuyper and N.Jackson will be the first thing he has to justify. Haaland was the house captain for almost everyone, so the lone-wolf picks decided the drama.

piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS AGAIN, SUKRUT STRETCHES CLEAR
piece.standfirst: 15 armbands on Haaland, a 2-point return, and the leader still pulls further ahead.
piece.big_picture: Haaland blanked for the second week running and the armband crowd paid. Sukrut was one of them, yet his lead over Aditya Dalal grew to 24. Dalal's long hot streak finally cooled. Pradnyesh's Tavernier call shows what going elsewhere could pay.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Aryamann swapped Mbeumo and Kostoulas for Wirtz and Evanilson. Best transfer of the week, and a big reason for the move into the Gold spots.
piece.one_to_watch: Aryamann and Anuj are split by 6 points at the Gold spots line. If Aryamann's new signings keep delivering, he could stay ahead. If Anuj fixes his bench, the gap could close fast.

piece.headline: HAALAND LETS 15 DOWN, SUKRUT SITS PRETTY
piece.standfirst: Haaland got the armband 15 times and returned 2 points. The rebels will be insufferable all week.
piece.big_picture: 3 weeks ago this was Dalal's crown. Now Sukrut has held it for 3 weeks and the gap is 24. Dalal had his lowest score in a 10-week run above average, and Haaland's armband did the rest. A chasing pack that all backed the same captain cannot catch a leader by copying each other.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Atharva Kshirsagar picked the wrong 11, and 36 points watched from the bench. Picking the right team keeps being the one job he cannot get right.

*Shantanu storms up the table!*
He hauled 65 to climb from 22nd to 20th, while the house captain Haaland only managed 2 for 15 of you.

hot:6543415.title: Streak Hits a Low
hot:6543415.text: Aditya Dalal's 8-week run above the league average is still alive, but 37 points in GW11 is the lowest score of the streak.
hot:6543415.next: Can Aditya Dalal bounce back from 37?

hot:6543415.title: 8 Weeks and Counting
hot:6543415.text: Aditya Dalal's streak of 8 weeks above the league average is still alive. The 37 points in GW11 was the lowest score of the run, and the next gameweek will show whether that was a blip.

bench:2784861.title: Bench Blunders Mount
bench:2784861.text: Atharva Kshirsagar has left 216 points on the bench this season, more than double the league average of 89. The question is whether the team sheet will ever get it right.

bench:2784861.title: Bench Points Keep Piling Up
bench:2784861.text: Atharva Kshirsagar has left 216 points on the bench this season, more than double the league average of 84. The team sheet is still costing him more than almost anyone else in the league.

underdog:3504829.title: Aryamann's Relentless Climb
underdog:3504829.text: Aryamann has climbed from 20th in GW2 to 4th now, 16 places in total. A 3-place jump in GW11 alone shows the climb is still gaining pace.

underdog:3504829.title: Aryamann Climbs Into the Top 4
underdog:3504829.text: Aryamann has risen from 20th in GW2 to 4th now, 16 places in total. He was 7th in GW10, so the climb has been picking up pace in recent weeks.
underdog:3504829.next: Rank 4 of 24. Could the podium be next?

chase:3234443.title: One Point Separates Them
chase:3234443.text: Atharva Kshirsagar leads Aditya Dharap by just 1 point, after the gap fell from 44 in GW8 to 11 in GW10 and then to 1 in GW11.

title.title: Sukrut's Lead Keeps Growing
title.text: Sukrut leads Aditya Dalal by 26 points, up from 24 in GW11. The lead has changed hands 5 times this season, and Prerana sits 27 points behind the leader.
title.next: Prerana is 27 behind. Anyone got an answer?

gold.title: Fighting for the Last Gold
gold.text: Aryamann holds the last Gold spot, with Anuj first out and a gap of 4. Anuj has spent 3 of the last 5 weeks in the zone to Aryamann's 2, so the spot is up for grabs.
gold.next: If Anuj wins one more week, the spot could change hands.
